payload.blocks: Phase 7 and the plan's done; phases 1-6 are landed and nothing else waits.
payload.headline: Who runs the red-tests plan's integration gate on the host, since a unit sandbox cannot?

parts.cause: A unit sandbox cannot reach the host state root, host processes or user namespaces, so it cannot produce a trustworthy full-suite gate. The lead's own confinement cannot run tests either. Only the land door runs on the host, and it runs named tests, not the full suite.

options.cost: One host run plus one lead pass.
options.does: Someone on the host runs npm test and cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast on current main (CARGO_TARGET_DIR on disk) and drops both logs where the lead can read them; the lead classifies each red and closes phase 7.
options.gain: Criterion 7 proven for real; any genuinely new red gets an owner.
options.harm: Needs a host session for about 15 minutes of suite time.
options.label: Host run by the owner or supervisor

options.does: Close phase 7 on the sandbox run: this plan's own files are green on the host, and the 57 npm files and 72 cargo failures stay recorded as sandbox reds, unverified.
options.harm: A real red hidden among the sandbox reds would go unowned; the secretary confinement case still never ran with bwrap.
options.label: Accept the sandbox gate

parts.recommendation: Host run: this plan's purpose is a main whose reds each have an owner, and the sandbox run cannot tell real reds from sandbox ones.

scope.allows: One host full-suite run on current main and the lead classifying its reds in the integration report.
scope.forbids: Fixing any red in this plan beyond its footprint, or skipping checks with env switches.

parts.what: Phase 7 must show npm test and cargo test --workspace green on main except named reds. Two unit runs on main 7180cca94 ran both suites inside the unit sandbox: cargo 72 failed, npm 296 failed in 57 files. None is in a file this plan changed (those passed their host land gates). Most carry sandbox signatures, unverified: read-only ~/.local/state/fgos (git-floor-probe-failed), PID namespace, no bwrap, no git identity. Report: plans/261122-0800-red-tests-and-backlog-sweep/reports/integration-gate.md.
